revenueProvenance.basis: Issuer consolidated revenue. Gaming tax/licensing fee is a separate expense ABOVE the reported GP in recent statements; do not add it to already pre-tax revenue or remove genuine GP. CostOfRevenue includes cost of sales plus that gaming-tax/licensing expense where separately reported.
revenueProvenance.operatingIncomeBasis: No issuer operating subtotal. Derived by summing all statement income/expense lines above finance costs, excluding share of associate results; equivalently PBT plus finance costs minus associate results. This deliberately retains reported financial-asset/liability fair-value gains/losses and property changes, and must not be called recurring-core operating earnings.
revenueProvenance.businessScope: Philippine hotel, property leasing and gaming operations, including direct casino operations under the disclosed arrangements. Prior football-related discontinued activity is excluded from re-presented FY2020 continuing revenue. Year end changed from March to June in FY2019 and from June to December in 2026.

annual.notes: Reported GP 273245 = revenue 566159 - gaming tax/licensing 180731 - cost of sales 112183. Total attributable NI -282145 is on the following statement page, not an FMP estimate.

interimPeriods.notes: Twelve months, not six and not audited FY2026. Includes 424911 fair-value loss on financial liabilities in the stated derived non-finance-cost subtotal; not recurring operating loss.

limitations: 1009-principal-casino-revenue-before-gaming-tax is common to FY2025, December 2024/2025 H1 and the June 2026 I2: all report principal casino revenue with gaming tax/licensing expense above GP. FY2025 minus December 2024 H1 and the corresponding December 2025 TTM are supported. I2 remains secondInterim, twelve months, never an annual/H2 merely because its accounting-basis group matches.

FY2024 is separately tagged 1009-leasing-to-principal-casino-transition because the direct casino takeover in May 2024 falls inside that year whereas December 2023 H1 predates it. No unreviewed leasing-to-principal revenue bridge is assumed. Football-discontinued and earlier fiscal-transition presentations remain separate.

All provider annual history through official audited FY2025 is reviewed. Provider FY2026 ending June is actually a twelve-month second interim: primary note 2 confirms year end changed from June to December on 2026-05-13. Expected transition FY is eighteen months 2025-07-01 to 2026-12-31; no final FY result exists in these sources.
FY2019 is fifteen months 2018-04-01 to 2019-06-30, not twelve months. September 2018 comparative is a genuine April-September six-month period and must not be relabelled December 2018.

Provider anomalous dates 2018-01-31, 2017-01-31 and calendar June observations cannot be certified as issuer H1 merely from labels. Canonical dates above follow the actual tables. Provider Q1/Q3 or a stand-alone Q2 must not be treated as cumulative H1 without reconciliation.

Latest first-interim notes disclose depreciation 49982/47979 and the balance sheet still carries intangible assets 3275/5386, but no complete matching intangible-amortization expense is disclosed in that report; full D&A remains null rather than inferring amortization from balance changes. FY2020 continuing-only D&A uses note 9's 48255 depreciation; note 4 allocates all 52589 amortization to discontinued football, excluded from continuing D&A.

Reported GP survives gaming-tax reconciliation: for FY2025 cost of sales alone is 112183 and gaming-tax/licensing expense is 180731. Our aggregate costOfRevenue is 292914, not a universal revenue gross-up.

Total attributable FY2020 NI and continuing attributable NI are separately preserved, with actual attributable continuing values printed on the following page. The FY2021 report has an audit qualification concerning comparative disposed-football information.
All per-share data is HKD per share, not HK cents or thousands; comparability tags deliberately distinguish calendar/fiscal transitions and known re-presentations.
